status: registered camera-WB paired probe; source-mirror only; no acceptance gate

dataset.permission_note: dataset page says images may be used and published with citation; not designated CC0
dataset.citation: A. Chakrabarti, D. Scharstein, and T. Zickler, An empirical camera model for Internet color vision, BMVC 2009

pair.conditions: wb1 fixed tungsten vs wb2 auto; i2 daylight; e3 nominal 0 EV
pair.alignment: registered ColorChecker composite per dataset description
pair.target_role: camera auto-WB rendition; not colorimetric ground truth
pair.transfer: camera JPEG sRGB renditions; inputs represented as encoded [0,1] RGB

roi.meaning: physical chart skin-tone and neutral patches; not human skin or natural white materials

measurement: CIE Lab D65/2-degree ΔE76 on clipped display sRGB decode; encoded-sRGB MAE/p95 and clipping ratios, per patch and ROI

method_source.evidence: independent Python transcription only; no compiled C++ differential

limitations: WB2 is a camera auto setting rather than calibrated GT
chart patches do not substitute for real skin/white objects
one camera, one illumination, one exposure
no alpha, HDR, ICC, performance or GPU path
no blinded visual review or acceptance gate
